exposure: Cloning (derived from somatic cells, ES cells, cumulus cells, TSA-treated cumulus cells)
outcome: DNA methylation (TIMP-2 and PBEF promoter regions)
Histone modification (H3-K9/K14 acetylation at TIMP-2 and PBEF loci)
cohort: Placentae from cloned mice (derived from cumulus cells, TSA-treated cumulus cells), ICSI-derived mice, and naturally mated (NM) control mice were analyzed.
finding: Cloned and TSA-treated cloned placentae showed higher TIMP-2 expression and lower PBEF expression compared to controls, which was associated with abnormal histone modification at the gene promoter regions rather than DNA methylation.
